achievements.name: Drop in the Ocean
achievements.description: Locate your crashed drop pod after arriving on planet 4546B.

achievements.name: Jukebox Hero
achievements.description: Build a Jukebox inside one of your bases.

achievements.name: Dressed For The Weather
achievements.description: Craft a Cold Suit to survive the surface's freezing temperatures.

achievements.name: Necessary Repairs
achievements.description: Repair the damaged bridge in the Glacial Basin using crafted Hydraulic Fluid.

achievements.name: Xenobiology
achievements.description: Encounter the sapient alien Architect Al-An for the first time at Shrine Zero.

achievements.name: Finding the Cure
achievements.description: Use the Kharaa antidote hidden by Sam to cure the Frozen Leviathan of its infection.

achievements.name: Another Survivor
achievements.description: Find Marguerit Maida's hidden base beneath the Purple Vents.

achievements.name: Pirate Radio
achievements.description: Disable Alterra's communications by overriding the Communications Tower and entering Test Mode.

achievements.name: Out of Mind
achievements.description: Construct Al-An's alien vessel from its three recovered Architect components.

achievements.name: Into the Unknown
achievements.description: Leave planet 4546B aboard Al-An's vessel and reach the Architect homeworld.
